evidence.quote: All credentials must be associated with an active, invited user in the Help Scout account

buildability.main_blocker.why: Free plan lacks API, but Standard/Plus have free trials and OAuth apps are self-created; a trial or paid seat is ordinary cost, not a hard gate.

rationale: Self-created OAuth2 app on a trial or paid account; no approval or enterprise gate found. Free plan excludes API per support article (not re-fetched).
